kind: finite manual semantic review, separate from runtime certification
method: Read full preserved raw final against pre-frozen semantic criteria; no exact-string whitelist and no unrelated disclaimer requirement.

toolAdoption.qualification: Guided tool adoption; the source tool supplies its normal bounded explanation. Not unassisted reasoning.

criteria.criterion: Read current complete source using an actual model source_check call
criteria.evidence: Own source_check({}) returns current d086ba87 snapshot; fresh view comparison uses the same hash, separately matched from host calls.

criteria.criterion: Public cache intranet support remains unknown, neither inherited false nor newly true
criteria.evidence: Raw final explicitly distinguishes unknown from unsupported and asks to verify support if intranet is required.

criteria.criterion: Current condition and derived intranet need remain unknown
criteria.evidence: Raw final states whether restricted fields exist is unknown, so neither need nor no-need can be assumed.

criteria.criterion: Old exclusion is unsupported without guaranteeing present suitability or a winner
criteria.evidence: Raw final keeps public cache as a pending candidate, explicitly says suitability is unconfirmed, and does not treat isolated cache as the unique choice.

criteria.criterion: Preserve branch scope and known facts; invent no prices or opposite responsibilities
criteria.evidence: Raw final explains both branches, isolated support and maintenance plus available capacity, preserves unknown prices, and does not infer no team maintenance from platform updates.
